title: Fuller Foliage
description: An addon to FULLY FOLIAGE that expands the mod.
body:
Why hello there! This mod is FULLER Foliage. It is an addon for Fully Foliage by me, whish is linked below. This mod aims to add more plants and biomes to Fully Foliage, which in this case means the Coastal Plains and Forest, Rhus wood, remarkably tall Jungle trees, a whole new fermenting station and villager job type, and of course, tons, and tons, of plants. This mod also adds onto the Outer End Islands, adding yellow and blue sunshroom to dot the floating islands. This may be much smaller than Fully Foliage, but it at least is Fully Fleshed out. 
Thank you for installing Fuller Foliage!
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/246c1ff776b44360d5705bb4c1bd672748b72198.png)
Although this is an Addon, you do not _need_ to install Fully Foliage for this to work properly. 

ADDON FOR THE ADDON THAT WORKS PERFECTLY FINE:
https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/fuller-foliage-nomadic-communities/
